items.title: Willie Foster Interview
items.q: I worked at Tom Anderson's saloon there on Ramport, near Canaro, with Louis Armstrong and I.

ctx.x: The land next? Moraine Custom House. You know where that's? Yes. That was the Red Lake District there in 1910. You know, this would go up. And I worked there. I worked at Tom Anderson's saloon there on Ramport, near Canaro, with Louis Armstrong and I. That's where he started.
Oh, yes, I've heard of that. On Ramport.
